Memora | Founding Engineer | REMOTE (EU, 4h overlap with CET) | Full-time | Senior IC salary + meaningful founding equity

We're a 5-person startup building software for cemetery & public-records management: municipalities managing data for real families. Broad, hands-on IC role with real product and infra ownership.

Stack: NestJS/TypeScript, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, MikroORM, Inngest · React + TanStack Query, MapLibre + PMTiles · React Native + Expo · AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, Bedrock, WAF) + Terraform · Grafana/Sentry · QGIS/GeoPackage geospatial.

You: 8+ yrs production, full-stack TS, owned a Terraform/AWS stack (not just consumed one), strong relational DB fundamentals, comfortable with no playbook. Bonus: PostGIS, RN/Expo, RLS/multi-tenancy, LLM, B2B/B2G.

We lean hard on AI tooling and expect you to: but the bar is human-reviewed, well-tested code; "the model said it worked" isn't a defence. Remote by design, quarterly offsites.

Apply here: https://zrec.eu/E0KZN
